$comment: Launcher manifest for the sakura-petals-everywhere mod. This file only DESCRIBES the mod; the value store stays the live %LOCALAPPDATA%\LeafItAloneSafe\sakura-petals-everywhere.json that apply.ps1 seeds and reads, and apply/revert run the validated scripts. Adding a mod means writing a manifest like this, never new launcher UI code.
name: Sakura petals everywhere
description: Brings the sakura map's special petal leaves into the other worlds. Each world keeps its own leaf counts and scatter, only the leaf material changes to the cherry-petal one (not a particle change; the leaves stay fully pickable).

fields.label: Petal leaves in Hometown
fields.help: Convert Hometown's leaves to the sakura petal look. Its leaf counts/positions stay the same.

fields.label: Petal leaves in Castle
fields.help: Convert the Castle's leaves to the sakura petal look. Its leaf counts/positions stay the same.
